page_title: BAR 1-0 ATM | Barcelona v Atletico Madrid 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Inaki Pena is alert and denies him.
90+3' Yellow card. Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+2' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes it short.
90+2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Barcelona.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' The ball is cleared after Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Pedri is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
88' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.

86' The opposition can't get near Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
84' The resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is cleared by the defence.
82' Xavi appears to have said too much and referee Jose Sanchez comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
81' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
81' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) brought his opponent down. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Atl. Madrid.
80' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) takes the free kick from just outside the box and unleashes a fine shot to the top left corner, but his effort is thwarted by Inaki Pena who parries it onto the post.
79' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
78' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Ferran Torres (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
77' Xavi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ferran Torres (Barcelona) replacing Joao Felix.
77' The substitution is prepared. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Raphinha.
76' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
74' Raphinha (Barcelona) is penalised for holding. Jose Sanchez signals a set piece.

69' A long pass finds Joao Felix (Barcelona) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
66' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Koke will be replaced by Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid).
65' Alvaro Morata goes off the pitch and Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
63' Inaki Pena displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

61' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Inaki Pena. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
60' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
58' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.

58' OFF THE POST! Raphinha (Barcelona) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
54' Pedri (Barcelona) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Jan Oblak comes off his line to intercept.
52' Raphinha (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Felix (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' Joao Felix (Barcelona) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Joao Felix (Barcelona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
47' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) is replaced by Samuel Lino.
46' Half-time substitution. Diego Simeone decided to make a change. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is replaced by Cesar Azpilicueta.
46' Diego Simeone makes a half-time substitution. Angel Correa comes on in place of Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
46' The whistle blows and Jose Sanchez starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' Joao Cancelo sends a terrific cross into the box. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

44' Joao Felix (Barcelona) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Jan Oblak blocks the shot with his legs.
43' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

43' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Barcelona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
42' Atl. Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
38' Koke (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
37' The corner kick from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

36' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
34' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.

33' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) gets a nice pass from Alvaro Morata on the edge of the box, he looks up and tries to beat the keeper in the corner but it goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
31' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Jose Sanchez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
28' 1 - 0 GOAL! Joao Felix (Barcelona) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Jan Oblak, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
25' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Raphinha (Barcelona).
22' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in a cross from the corner, but Jan Oblak reads it well and gathers the ball.
22' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. Barcelona earn a corner.
19' Raphinha (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
19' An attempted cross from Raphinha (Barcelona) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
16' The free kick is delivered by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

15' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Sanchez interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Atl. Madrid, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
13' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Jules Kounde, but the ball goes a whisker wide of the right post.
12' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
9' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. It's a throw-in for Barcelona.
8' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul after Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) hacks down one of his opponents.
7' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Raphinha, but sends his close-range header way wide of the right post.
5' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) plays a one-two with Marcos Llorente, but the move breaks down.
3' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner kick, but Jan Oblak reads it well and stops the effort.

3' What a great touch by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.

2' Raphinha (Barcelona) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Barcelona will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jose Sanchez.
